ev.q: A total of 373 SARS cases identified in the United States have been reported from 41 states and Puerto Rico
with 306 (82%) cases classified as suspect SARS and 67 (18%) classified as probable SARS
One probable and nine suspect cases have been identified since the previous update
Of the 67 probable cases, 65 (97%) were attributed to international travel
